passed.description: true if the page loaded and a full review could be performed

reaction.description: Brutally honest, immediate first impression of the page (the 3-second rule)

filter.description: Which of the 6 baby friction filters this violates: 3-second-clarity | cognitive-dread | visual-abstraction | scannability | mental-math | click-depth

element.description: Exact UI element/region reference (heading, button, table column, etc.)

quote.description: Verbatim problematic copy/label text, or null if purely visual/structural

why.description: Why this confuses or slows down a first-time, zero-context user

prescription.description: Prioritized concrete fixes: what to delete, simplify, or visually replace

failure_reason.description: Why the review could not be completed (e.g. auth wall, page crash), or null on success
